## Scope

Describe the problem and the bounded change.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No secret, production data, backup, recovery audit, or local environment file is included.
- [ ] API, Agent protocol, Operation state machine, migration, and feature-flag effects are stated.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied code have compatible, documented licenses and provenance.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has negative tests and fails closed.

## Validation

List the exact local and integration checks run. Production deployment and
canary authorization are separate from code review.
